key_insight: QECLean uses machine-checked proofs to verify quantum error-correcting code properties, including an exact distance of 24 for IBM’s [[360, 12]] code.
engineering_relevance: Verified code specifications provide a foundation for reasoning about circuit implementations and building end-to-end verified quantum compilers.
method: Specify and verify QEC codes in Lean using common abstractions.
Compose analytical distance proofs with code combinators.
Formalize entire code families, including surface codes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports proving IBM’s [[360, 12]] code has distance 24, previously known only as an upper bound, and formalizing and proving properties of code families such as the surface code.
watch_item: Code-level proofs alone do not establish correctness of hardware-specific circuits or an end-to-end quantum compiler.
